correctness.rationale: The congruence action by a diagonal one-parameter subgroup preserves symmetric matrix rank. Choosing weights 2^i makes all projective symmetric-coordinate weights 2^i+2^j pairwise distinct, so the ambient fixed points are exactly the coordinate matrices. Diagonal coordinate matrices have rank one and off-diagonal symmetric coordinate matrices have rank two. Euler fixed-point localization therefore gives n for the rank-one locus and binomial(n+1,2) for every cumulative rank bound at least two. Constructible additivity gives binomial(n,2) for exact rank two and zero for every exact rank at least three. The package checker independently verifies the coordinate-weight and counting steps through n=100.

value.rationale: Symmetric determinantal loci are fundamental singular projective varieties, and their exact-rank decomposition is canonical. The theorem shows that every global Euler contribution above rank two cancels: the entire rank tower from rank two to the ambient projective space has one constant Euler characteristic, while every exact-rank stratum of rank at least three has Euler characteristic zero. This gives a structural topological simplification useful for constructible-function and characteristic-class decompositions, rather than a parameter-specific numerical coincidence.
